reason: The tricks sound like fun for the kids and my class, and 99 ₪ isn't the issue for me. But an app I install from the browser and pay for with my card on some website I've never heard of — that's exactly what I don't do.
objection: Typing my card number into an unknown app website, and installing something outside the App Store that wants access to my gallery, notes and calls, feels risky.
would_change_my_mind: If it were in the App Store or Google Play, so I pay through Apple or Google and can get a refund if it doesn't work.
